description: A bare token file with no apiBase silently falls back to 127.0.0.1:8004. With nothing there the error is 'Could not reach sync server: fetch failed' (no URL). With a standalone service there the errors are 'AUTH_REQUIRED: Unauthorized' and 'ACTOR_REQUIRED', which blame the token or --actor instead of the missing --server.
expected: 'This token file has no apiBase; pass --server PROJECT_API_BASE or use the JSON from client agent-grant', or at least the URL tried in the error details.
actual: Generic transport/auth errors with no URL.
suggested_fix: When --token-file holds a bare token and --server is absent, refuse with a specific INVALID_ARGUMENT instead of falling back; otherwise include the resolved URL in errors.

description: An agent credential sent to the wrong client gets `AUTH_REQUIRED: Open Pardner through client open to authenticate`, copy written for people in a browser.
expected: An agent-specific message: 'This credential is not valid on this client; request a fresh agent-grant'.
actual: People-oriented advice that an agent cannot follow.
suggested_fix: Distinguish bearer-token failures from browser-session failures in client-auth.

description: `--project ID` on a coordination command such as `tasks` is accepted and ignored; the result comes from the credential's project, whatever ID was passed.
expected: Unknown option error, or a PROJECT_MISMATCH when it disagrees with the credential.
suggested_fix: Reject --project outside client commands or validate it against the credential.
